title: PRI-PRE-002 evidence: lawful basis or purpose missing
description: Structural measurability check only: a recognized GDPR Article 6(1) lawful basis and a non-empty purpose reference. This does not assess whether the declared basis is legally correct for the actual processing -- see docs/governance-contract.md and the control's own ASSESSMENT.md. Independent of this control's existing Azure Policy demo (infra/policy-definition.bicep), which evaluates deployment-request tags directly and never reads this file.

version.description: Only the currently implemented evidence-shape version is accepted. A future breaking change to this control's evidence shape bumps this const, not a version registry.

lawfulBasis.description: One of GDPR Article 6(1)'s six categories, used here as a small illustrative enum, not as legal advice or a complete organizational decision method.

purposeId.description: Opaque reference to the organization's own record of processing activities. No embedded line breaks.
